navigationCoordination.scope: Native tool-local conservative union of original AOI obstacles, active controlled owner receipts and one in-flight movement hint per connection; never authoritative occupancy, snapshots or AOI.
navigationCoordination.blockedOpportunityRule: A conflicting prepared move is still an offered navigation-blocked/native opportunity; original cadence, completion and correction gates remain.

nativePatrolPlanning.scope: Native primed patrol fallback only; original fast path and at most four existing corner targets remain.
nativePatrolPlanning.selectionRule: Prefer the first existing collision-aware path with two legal collinear Run steps; otherwise retain the original first Walk.
nativePatrolPlanning.primingRule: Only while native Run priming is active; original cadence, transfer/coverage checks and offered-opportunity accounting remain.

measurementClock.scope: All measurement phases; seconds retains configured duration and measuredSeconds is actual elapsed wall time.
measurementClock.completeWindowCountRule: At least floor(configured seconds / 60) complete windows, each starting at the previous actual close, plus the full configured phase duration.
measurementClock.durationRule: Activity and rate assessment use actual measuredSeconds; no short window is relabelled as sixty seconds or duplicated after a stall.
measurementClock.partialWindowRule: The final partial minute remains in whole-phase and continuous assessment, without counting as a complete rolling window.

nativeHpMaintenance.scope: Already-held ordinary HP potions only; no MP, purchase, grants or revival.
nativeHpMaintenance.rule: Fresh matching UseItem success plus complete-inventory consumption or exact HP increase within the same deadline; consumption is not proof of healing.
nativeHpMaintenance.activityRule: Independent auxiliary promise; native opportunities continue and HP maintenance never credits movement, attack or native completion.

nativeAttackWitness.scope: New native attack witness selection; the original full AOI membership range remains16.
nativeAttackWitness.rule: Choose the nearest active living same-map observer that actually sees both attacker and target; reselect immediately before send. No witness leaves the native opportunity incomplete.
nativeAttackWitness.approachRule: Native approach paths require a current active living same-map observer whose actual snapshot contains both attacker and target and whose actual position is within6 of the target and prospective attack tile; otherwise continue other eligible targets or ordinary scouting.
nativeAttackWitness.damageRule: Original dual-end damage/health evidence,900ms deadline and ambiguous-target quarantine remain unchanged.
